scenario_data.body: I am not sure how long we hold each other.
By the time I realize it, it is deep into the night.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Reluctantly, we take a small step back"
and gaze into each other's faces.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "We're not best friends anymore... we're lovers."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I feel a little shy... but really happy:"
We give a small laugh and, once again, embrace each other.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "If we don't go home soon, do you think the others at 'Famille' will worry?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Oh... yeah, we should probably head back."
I firmly grip Aoi's hand, and we head back to 'Famille.
Almost as if she had predicted when we would be home,
the moment we open the entrance, Sayaka appears from the living room.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "I thought it would be about time you guys got back."
Sayaka gives us her usual gentle smile.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "William. So you were able to tell her."
Next, Sayaka glances over at Aoi.
Aoi is on the verge of tears, and Sayaka gently pats her head.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I really am no match for her...)
Aoi is on the verge of tears, and Sayaka gently pats her head.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Hehe. If you need help again, feel free to tell me."

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "Honestly... causing us to worry like that."

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "Exactly! Where have you been all this time!?"
Though it is way passed dinner, all the girls have gathered in the living room.
Filled with gratitude, I look each resident in the face...
Considering that they were just all upset we were late,
all of them appear to be grinning...

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "Well... we'll forgive you for being to come back home."

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "As long as you tell us about the romance... that turned you two into lovers! "
Then, Sayaka, who is grinning the most out of everyone,
points in finger in between me and Aoi.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "You two... how long do you plan to hold hands?"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "You two turn up with red faces and, to top it off, you're holding hands."
B-But the fact that it's obvious our relationship is no longer best friends but lovers...
Isn't that something I should be happy about?

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "So? Which of your professed your love first?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (A-are we supposed to tell them here and now!?)

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Hehe. Hey, come on. We can tell them that much."

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Alright, who went for the kiss first?"
H-how can this woman ask something like that so casually!?
Perhaps a little too embarrassed, Aoi's face turns bright red.
And she slowly begins to step further away from me.

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Aoi. If you step too far away from William, this time I might actually take him from you."
Aoi shouts, clutching onto my body, her face bright red.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I won't let anyone have William... n-not even you Sayaka!!!"

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Hehe. Does that mean you were smitten by Aoi's words?"
Aoi's smile appears right before my eyes, and sends me to the brink of explosion.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Ahhhhh!!! I'm really happy, but also really embarrassment!)

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "So, William, since when have you had feelings for Aoi?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Urgh! I-is the interrogation still going to continue!?"
Somehow recovering, we finish dinner, and Aoi and I go out into the balcony.
Looking up into the night sky, there are countless shining stars.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I didn't notice when we were on the hill."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Were you too carried away by me?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I-I... still can't get used to being clung to!!!)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (B-but... well, I guess there's no need to get used to it...)

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Hm! Even someone like me has a few fantasies!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Besides, I do believe that if you wish on a shooting star, your wish will come true!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Well, what would you wish for, Aoi?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Well, I have wish, but... I don't I can say it three times before the shooting star disappears."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "That I can always be with you, William."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I just saw a shooting star over there!!!"
Aoi leans over the balcony and droops her shoulders.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Aww... just as I thought, I couldn't say my wish three times."
I slowly stand up and walk up next to Aoi.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Ahaha... well, cheer up. Maybe another shooting star will fly by."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Now that I think about it... my wish will come true, even if I don't wish on a star!"
Aoi, her cheeks flushed, fixes her eyes on me.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Because... I'll always be by your side, William."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "My wish that I'll always be with you, William..."
We gaze at each other, as if pulled together by some unseen force.
Just by gazing at each other, Aoi understands my intentions.
Finally this time, not as best friends, but. as lovers...
As I attempt to calm my pounding heart,
I slowly grasp both of Aoi's shoulders.
As gently as possible, I come close to Aoi,
and then I kiss her lips.
The kiss is sweet and soft.
Looking more happier than I've ever seen her, Aoi smiles.
Blushing, we gaze at each other.
And beneath the starry night sky, once again, we kiss...
